releases.name: Artifact Laser v.1.1.0
releases.body:
-Fixes a bug where owlks would burn the whole time they held you.
-Adds a sizzling sound when owlks are burning.
-Owlks that are burning emit death particles.
-A kill counter now appears once at least one owlk is killed.
-Added a killfeed that shows the names of owlks who are killed, along with a funny little message.
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了一个问题，即在 owlks 持有你的整个过程中，它们会一直燃烧。
- 当 owlks 燃烧时，添加了滋滋声。
- 正在燃烧的 owlks 会发出死亡粒子。
- 当至少杀死一只 owlks 后，会出现一个击杀计数器。
- 添加了一个击杀信息板，显示被杀 owlks 的名字，以及一条有趣的简短信息。

releases.name: Artifact Laser v.1.0.0
releases.body: The initial release for my mod! Allows the player to kill the Dreamworld inhabitants by focusing the artifact light on them.
releases.bodyZh: 我的模组的初始发布！允许玩家通过将神器光芒聚焦在它们身上来杀死梦境世界的居民。
